# Lifee - Personal Career & Global Life Decision Intelligence System
> An evidence-grounded decision intelligence application for global career and emigration pathways.

## Core Directives
- Universal Zero-Hallucination & Evidence-First Rule
- Source Tiers: Tier A (Official Gov/Immigration/Laws) to Tier E (Community Ground Truth)
- Target Baseline Profile: Associate Degree (3D Digital Media), ~1500 English vocabulary, ~$0 startup capital, needs immediate remote cashflow.
- Top Pathways: German Dual Vocational (Ausbildung), Malaysia DE Rantau Nomad, Japan SSW, NZ WHV, Domestic Remote Studio.

## Data Endpoints
- /data/summary.json: Compact machine-readable snapshot of occupations, countries, and verified policy citations.
